items.summary: Public RFC locks Economics v2 before any height switch: target 0.1 HMC/empty block, ~4-year halvings from genesis, permanent 0.002 HMC tail, no hard max-supply fiction, pool funded from emission (not perpetual treasury top-ups), clearer order fee/burn, SUP as utility.
